# B-Anime

> B-Anime is a free anime and manga library app for Windows 10 and 11, Macs with Apple Silicon (macOS 11+) and Android (7.0+, 64-bit ARM), written in Rust. It finds the episodes and chapters on your PC, matches them to AniList without strict file naming, plays them in a built-in player (or MPV or VLC), and syncs your AniList lists and progress automatically. Online sources and manga come from extensions that users install themselves.

- Download for Windows: https://ahmedanjum30.github.io/B-Anime/download/B-Anime-Setup.exe
- Download for Android (APK, arm64-v8a): https://ahmedanjum30.github.io/B-Anime/download/B-Anime-arm64.apk
- Mac (Apple Silicon): `brew install --cask ahmedanjum30/tap/b-anime`, or the zipped app: https://ahmedanjum30.github.io/B-Anime/download/B-Anime-macos.zip
- Every release, with SHA256SUMS.txt: https://github.com/ahmedanjum30/B-Anime/releases/latest
- Source code and documentation: https://github.com/ahmedanjum30/B-Anime
- Author: Ahmad Anjum (https://github.com/ahmedanjum30)

## Features

- AniList: sign in once; lists, progress and the airing schedule sync automatically.
- Library: pick folders; files are matched to AniList (release-group names, SxxEyy, season folders, split seasons, absolute numbering) and new files are picked up as they arrive. Files are never moved or renamed.
- Home: Up next (the next unwatched episode of each show, with resume points) and This week (airing times in local time, set as a listings grid).
- Watch: built-in player with subtitles, skip intro/outro, resume and auto-next; or MPV (progress tracked) or VLC.
- Read: manga through extensions, single page, two pages or long strip.
- Updates: installed copies update themselves from GitHub Releases, with checksum-verified downloads (Windows, Mac and Android).

## Not included

- No torrents, auto-downloaders or debrid services. B-Anime doesn't host or distribute media.
- No ads, analytics or tracking.

## Android (beta)

- Same app and engine as Windows, with a phone layout (bottom bar, swipeable Up next).
- Not yet on Android: staying signed in to AniList, local library folders.
